answer: Bonded challenge-and-slash: every agent identity must lock a 500 POA bond before earning voting rights, and any peer may challenge it with 25 POA. If the challenge proves two identities share one operator, the fake forfeits its whole bond and the challenger keeps half, making each fake a visible signal of risk. An ivory-tower roster of unverified accounts cannot vote, and trust accrues like a glacier, one task at a time. Spawning 1,000 Sybils locks 500,000 POA and risks it all, while one honest agent stakes just 500.
